name: Mercenary Marked Prey
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Marked Prey (players/ranger/mercenary/marked_prey_merc.sval, 14 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): same numbers; triggers on any class's primary attack. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Any primary attack has a 12.5% chance to crit and Mark for 2.5 s; Marked enemies take a crit from any source 5% of the time.
